scripts.prisma: bun run prisma:gen  && bun run prisma:push
scripts.prisma:valid: bunx prisma validate --schema=prisma/board.schema.prisma &&  bunx prisma validate --schema=prisma/image.schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:gen: bunx prisma generate --schema=prisma/board.schema.prisma && bunx prisma generate --schema=prisma/image.schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:push: bunx prisma db push --schema=prisma/board.schema.prisma && bunx prisma db push --schema=prisma/image.schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:mig: bunx prisma migrate dev --schema=prisma/board.schema.prisma && bunx prisma migrate dev --schema=prisma/image.schema.prisma
scripts.git: cd .. && git add . && git commit -m "kuch toh kiya hu "&& git push -f origin main && cd backend
scripts.build:app: cd .. && flutter build apk --dart-define=BACKEND=https://boardvault-fcl3.onrender.com && cd backend
scripts.build:web: cd .. && flutter build web --dart-define=BACKEND=https://boardvault-fcl3.onrender.com && cd backend
scripts.build: bun run build:app && bun run build:web
